segments.t: La mañana del martes amanece clara y luminosa en Linden Courtyard Inn. Evelyn baja deprisa a la recepción, donde Hannah y Graham la esperan con su maleta recuperada. Escucha primero toda la escena en inglés.
Good morning, Miss Evelyn! Look what arrived at our gate last night.
My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, my red ribbon!
And your teacup inside? Is it still in one piece?
Not a single crack! Who brought it back?
We do not know. Someone left it on the step and rang the bell.
And he did not ask for his own suitcase with the wooden train?
He left a short note asking us to keep it until Friday.
How curious! The handwriting on that tag felt oddly familiar to me.
Really? Do you know someone in Portland?
Twenty-five years ago I taught piano near here, though memories fade.
For now, his bag stays safe under lock and key.
Wonderful! Now I am ready for a big breakfast.
Ahora repasemos la conversación paso a paso.
Good morning, Miss Evelyn! Look what arrived at our gate last night.
'¡Buenos días, señorita Evelyn! Mire lo que llegó anoche a nuestra entrada.'
My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, my red ribbon!
'¡Mi maleta! Déjeme abrir el bolsillo superior... ¡sí, mi cinta roja!'
And your teacup inside? Is it still in one piece?
'¿Y su taza de té adentro? ¿Sigue entera?'
Not a single crack! Who brought it back?
'¡Ni una sola grieta! ¿Quién la trajo de vuelta?'
We do not know. Someone left it on the step and rang the bell.
'No lo sabemos. Alguien la dejó en el escalón y tocó el timbre.'
And he did not ask for his own suitcase with the wooden train?
'¿Y no preguntó por su propia maleta con el tren de madera?'
He left a short note asking us to keep it until Friday.
'Dejó una nota corta pidiéndonos que la guardemos hasta el viernes.'
How curious! The handwriting on that tag felt oddly familiar to me.
'¡Qué curioso! La letra de esa etiqueta me resultó extrañamente familiar.'
Really? Do you know someone in Portland?
'¿De verdad? ¿Conoce a alguien en Portland?'
Twenty-five years ago I taught piano near here, though memories fade.
'Hace veinticinco años di clases de piano cerca de aquí, aunque los recuerdos se desvanecen.'
For now, his bag stays safe under lock and key.
'Por ahora, su maleta se queda segura bajo llave.'
Wonderful! Now I am ready for a big breakfast.
'¡Estupendo! Ahora estoy lista para un buen desayuno.'
Volvamos a escuchar toda la escena seguida.

See you soon!
